The SKILL body is never truncated. When that body is below the budget, the
generated additions (file index and previous-step summary) are fitted into
the remaining space. The full file list remains with the workflow engine
for disk traversal, output comparison and quality gates.

Capsule mode deliberately keeps the established ``--resume`` recovery
contract.  Disabling persistence made crash/network recovery start from a
fresh conversation, which can duplicate partial writes and increase cost.
Workspace plaintext and export leakage are handled independently.

services.cli_gateway_proxy.doc:
Per-process loopback credentials for the desktop CLI and model tools.

The child process never receives the reusable provider API key. It receives an
opaque loopback token while the backend keeps the provider credential in memory
and forwards only the ticket's allowed CLI, chat or image route. This transport
does not require a remote Modex Gateway, response signature, or attestation.
Unbound tokens have a monotonic-clock TTL. Only the backend can bind a token
to its child; then process lifetime, explicit revocation and request quota
bound its use, including long-running calculations without intervening calls.

classes.name: CliProviderResponse
classes.doc:
Own an upstream response until its bytes have been consumed.

Keeping this object open lets Starlette forward SSE chunks as they arrive
instead of buffering a complete Claude response before the child sees it.

Transfer an unexpired token to its backend-owned CLI process.

Only the in-process launcher can do this, never an HTTP token holder.

No expired token can be revived or transferred to a different process.

functions.name: _admission_retry_delay
functions.doc:
Return a delay only for a cryptographically scoped pre-dispatch proof.

A bare 429/5xx is not evidence that the model POST was not accepted.  The
New API must add ``X-Modex-Admission: not-dispatched`` and the bounded JSON
contract below before this function will authorize another POST.  This is
deliberately stricter than treating every upstream 500 as transient: a
gateway can return 500 after the provider has already accepted the request.
Retrying that response would duplicate billing and tool/file side effects.

A local New API admission marker AND its exact bounded JSON contract must
agree. New API filters that reserved header out of upstream responses.

This small wait lets a concurrent recharge become visible without turning
an already dispatched request into a second paid call.

functions.name: readonly_selection
functions.doc:
Select the bounded source closure for a read-only editor turn.

The previous implementation seeded the dependency resolver with *every*
text file below 2 MiB.  A normal paper workspace can contain thousands of
result records and notes, so the resolver hit its 32 MiB safety budget before
it reached the actual source file.  That was both slow and misleading: the
editor then reported a failed run even though the requested document was
perfectly readable.

Roots are deliberately limited to the currently opened file, the document's
configured primary source, and files explicitly named by the user.  The
resolver still follows real ``input/include/import`` references from those
roots, and omitted materials remain listed in the manifest so the model
cannot claim to have read them.  There is no workspace-wide byte budget;
only the existing per-file safety guard applies.  ``primary`` is optional
for callers that do not have a mode descriptor (tests and small
integrations).

Bind explicitly named creations/outputs to project-relative paths.

Not a general NLP planner: only direct verb + path lists qualify. Examples,
questions, negative requests and source inputs are not deliverables.

services.editor_conversation.doc:
Resolve short confirmations against a bounded, user-authored task chain.

AI prose is context, never the source of authority. Unrelated questions, a
cancelled/discarded task, and completed writes all end a confirmation chain.
No disk or application state is changed while resolving a target.

services.editor_disclosure.doc: Synchronize the existing user-confirmed AI attachment, never invent records.

functions.name: normalize_ai_disclosure
functions.doc:
Return a canonical disclosure payload or ``None`` when disabled.

``strict=False`` is used only while reopening legacy workflows.  It still
never invents missing facts; instead it returns an explicit invalid marker
which makes the paper step stop and request a fresh, truthful declaration.

functions.name: synchronize
functions.doc:
Called off-loop inside the editor's licensed export scope, on a draft.

Always regenerate for used-mode: a successful check-only result cannot prove
that context-dependent prose still matches freshly edited chapters/code.
The existing signed generator inserts the statement BEFORE main compilation.

services.editor_export_resume.doc:
Resume a verified draft's failed export without replaying paid model edits.

Only newly recorded, hash-bound receipts qualify. Old prose diagnostics are
never guessed into success or used to bypass a missing execution receipt.

services.editor_exports.doc: Fresh-build exports with a source/output receipt; never accept a stale PDF.

functions.doc:
Evidence only for model-edited derived Word; ordinary source edits skip it.

Merely changing some Markdown bytes is not proof that the DOCX edit was
synchronized. Remember actual added/removed paragraphs across the rebuild.

functions.name: check_word_source_edits
functions.doc:
Never overwrite a DOCX-only edit using an unchanged authoritative source.

Standalone Word files without a Markdown source are not derived outputs and
remain editable. This check is local and precedes any expensive export.

functions.doc:
Resolve local source references, including absent references (hash='').

Tracks actual includes/images/bibliography, not every unrelated workspace file.
Dynamic tool reads are added by observe_reads below.

functions.name: synchronize_plain_word_edits
functions.doc:
Sync uniquely located plain prose, never reverse-convert math/media/layout.

The file transaction still checks user scope, source integrity and versions.
Ambiguous/formatted edits remain in the Word draft with a precise diagnostic.

services.editor_images.doc:
Image execution: fixed payer/model, durable dispatch fence, transactional files.

This is not the account wallet adapter. Never use an account's local Key as a
fallback. A lost provider response stays uncertain and is never auto-redispatched.
The caller holds the workspace writer lease until this function completes.

Next line from the file, as a bytes object.

Retain newline.  A non-negative size argument limits the maximum
number of bytes to return (an incomplete line may be returned then).
Return an empty bytes object at EOF.

This is execution evidence, not a universal shell parser. Listings,
syntax checks and unrelated successful commands cannot clear a failed

functions.name: check_figure_refresh
functions.doc:
For a visual edit, don't compile an unchanged old derived image.

Only enforce known exact source/output pairs; do not guess all outputs of
a shared helper or insist that direct-included TikZ has a separate PDF.

functions.name: independent_figures
functions.doc:
Only complete, validated figure bundles may survive a paper export failure.

Never partially publish chapters/data/helpers whose downstream meaning is
unclear. Changed generators require a changed image with matching identity.

If there is no value for the variable in the current context, the method will:

consts.name: PROGRESS_PROMPT
consts.value:
'
## 小范围编辑与进度
先从论文引用顺序或当前选中文件定位用户指的那一张图/那一段。只改配色时保留数据、公式、文字内容与其他图；不要重跑建模或求解，不重做全文审计，不自行修改 AI 使用声明、凭据或编译报告。使用已有结果重新生成指定图，后端负责统一论文导出。
工具之间用一句简短中文向用户说明当前目标、定位到的文件或实际阻碍，不输出内部推理。尚未校验/发布时必须说工作副本，不说已经完成。遇到系统凭据缺失等非内容错误应说明并停止，不反复尝试重建私人记录。
'

services.editor_python.doc:
Workspace Python launch paths, independent of host/embedded ._pth settings.

One-click execution and the Agent's materialized entry point use the same
stdlib bootstrap. Never edit user source, Python installation or global paths.

functions.name: local_imports
functions.doc: Resolve only existing local modules, without importing/executing them.

functions.name: runtime_modules
functions.doc:
Find imports of shipped helpers; never authorize guessed module names.

Existing public source may depend on more than plot_utils/stats_utils. The
authenticated package's policy resolves transitive imports afterwards.

services.editor_recall.doc:
Incremental, private local index of all editor receipts and archived turns.

The original JSON records remain authoritative. SQLite is a rebuildable cache,
not a model-generated memory and never a reason to repeat a paid operation.

services.editor_runs.doc: Durable editor turns. A disconnected subscriber never owns/cancels work.

functions.name: approval_target
functions.doc:
Bind explicit write approval to a user-authored goal, never AI prose.

Old versions could mark an explicit edit as a successful readonly answer.
Re-parse its original request, preserving the original scope. Do not rerun
completed edits or search past an unrelated real task to find old authority.

functions.name: release_completed_draft
functions.doc: Drop only our completed duplicate; keep receipts and failed drafts.

errors.name: WorkspaceBusy
errors.doc: Unspecified run-time error.

services.editor_tex_runtime.doc:
Child-process-only TeX resource alignment, without changing user settings.

The portable MiKTeX binary can still resolve a globally installed bibliography
style. Prefer the project's own resources, then the styles shipped with that
binary; leave the normal search path available as a final fallback.

services.editor_tools.doc:
Cancellation-safe ownership of synchronous editor tools.

Stopping is acknowledged only after owned threads drain. Managed subprocesses
are terminated by exact PID; foreign model/workflow processes are never touched.

functions.doc:

原始映射和 os.environ 均不会被修改。

functions.name: check_cancelled

services.editor_transactions.doc:
Baseline-based editor drafts, validated atomic publication and guarded undo.

Receipts/backups stay private. No model claim is treated as proof of a write.
Multi-file changes have a durable journal; incomplete commits are recoverable.

functions.name: _copy_one
functions.doc:
Copy a single file, tolerating a *transient* lock on it.

A viewer or indexer holding a PDF/figure for a moment used to fail the whole
run, even though the file was readable a moment later.  Retries are bounded
and only for sharing violations: a permission error, a full disk or a missing
file is reported immediately, and the file is never skipped — an incomplete
snapshot stays unsafe.

functions.doc:
Recover an interrupted commit/undo only when bytes match its journal.

Unknown external edits are never overwritten; the whole workspace is held

services.effort.doc:
思考强度（effort）——Claude CLI `--effort` 参数的单一真相源。

为什么单独一个模块：claude_runner / chat_session / workflow_engine / routers.settings
四处都要用同一份判据。B2 的教训是「同一份判据散在两处必漏一个」（当时是两道中间件
都在查控制 token，只改一道等于没改）。

⛔ 关键约束：CLI 对非法值**直接报错退出**，不是降级：
     error: option '--effort <level>' argument 'bogus' is invalid.
     It must be one of: low, medium, high, xhigh, max
   所以任何进入 cmd 的值必须先过 sanitize()。脏值会让整个步骤启动失败。

⛔ 另一条：中转（Go 写的 new-api）只反序列化 ClaudeRequest 里声明过的字段，
   裸 API 传 output_config.effort 会被**静默丢弃**（实测乱值返回 200 而非 400）。
   所以只能走 CLI flag，不要改成在回环代理里注入请求体。

functions.name: cli_args
functions.doc:
生成 cmd 片段。非法/空 → 空列表（完全不出现 --effort）。

⛔ 不能返回 ["--effort", ""] —— CLI 会把空串当非法值报错退出。

functions.name: sanitize
functions.doc:
白名单过滤，返回合法档位或 ""（表示不传 flag）。

"" 的语义是「不加 --effort」，等价于 API 默认的 high。
大小写、空白都归一；非字符串、None、非法值一律 → ""。

functions.name: supports_xhigh
functions.doc:
该模型能不能真正吃到 xhigh。不能则 CLI 静默降级为 high（不报错）。

仅用于界面提示，不用于拦截 —— 降级是安全行为，没必要阻止用户选。

services.execution_capacity.doc:
Process-local task registry, shared by automatic/chat/editor Skills.

The backend instance guard guarantees one process owns the data directory.
No global concurrency quota. Workspace write locks remain the safety boundary.

errors.name: ExecutionStopped
errors.doc: Unspecified run-time error.

services.export_runtime.doc:
Minimal public runtime support for reproducible workspace exports.

The generated figure/table programs import a tiny stable runtime, while the
rest of ``shared-scripts`` contains private recipes, review rules and audit
logic.  Export code must therefore be allow-list based and decrypt approved
files directly to memory; it must never rebuild the complete workspace
``_utils`` directory merely to create a ZIP.

functions.name: export_path_is_safe
functions.doc: Reject protected paths and junctions, while full exports retain _tmp data.

functions.name: iter_export_files
functions.doc: Prune private/link directories BEFORE walking, not after reading files.

functions.name: load_public_runtime_files
functions.doc:
Load approved runtime modules into memory for direct ZIP insertion.

The result maps ZIP-relative names to bytes. No plaintext is written to the
workspace or a temporary directory.

functions.name: prepare_export_runtime
functions.doc:
Best-effort PUBLIC dependencies; never deny download of owned artifacts.

The strict loader remains fail-closed. Failed authentication/decryption must
omit the helper, not copy unverified workspace _utils or private recipes.
Warnings deliberately contain no provider response, credential or host path.

functions.name: required_runtime_modules
functions.doc:
Return every top-level ``_utils`` module imported by Python files.

AST parsing handles aliases and multi-import statements.  A narrow regex
fallback protects export of syntactically incomplete user files without
silently missing an obvious protected dependency.

'

errors.name: HTTPException
errors.doc:
An HTTP exception you can raise in your own code to show errors to the client.

This is for client errors, invalid authentication, invalid data, etc. Not for server
errors in your code.

Read more about it in the
[FastAPI docs for Handling Errors](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/handling-errors/).

## Example

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

app = FastAPI()

items = {"foo": "The Foo Wrestlers"}


@app.get("/items/{item_id}")
async def read_item(item_id: str):
    if item_id not in items:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not found")
    return {"item": items[item_id]}
```

services.instance_guard.doc:
后端实例守护：孤儿回收、同数据目录互斥、父进程看护。

治三个真实故障（都是用户实测反馈的）：

**① 后端变孤儿，端口号一路往上爬。**
   Electron 的 `killBackend()` 只挂在 `before-quit` 上。用户从任务管理器结束
   进程、关机超时被强杀、软件自己崩溃 —— 这三种都不会走到它。而 Windows 上
   `child_process.spawn` 没把子进程绑进 job object，父进程死了 Python 照样活着，
   还霸着 18088。实测：强杀父 Node 后子进程仍 LISTENING。
   于是每强杀一次就多一个孤儿，Electron 探测时只能往上挪 → 18089 → 18090。
   （用户截图里报的正是 18090，说明前面躺了两个。）

**② 两个后端并存会让同一个工作流被跑两遍。**
   比端口占用严重得多：`main.py` 的 lifespan 里有 `get_workflows_to_resume()` +
   `run_workflow()`。两个后端指向同一个 DB 时，同一个 wf_id 会被双方各自 resume，
   两个 claude 进程写同一个工作区 —— 产物互相覆盖，钱也花两份。
   SQLite 开了 WAL + busy_timeout=30s，不会立刻写坏库，所以这个冲突**不会报错**，
   只会静默地把结果搅乱。必须在进程层面互斥。

**③ pid 文件按数据目录天然隔离。**
   文件放在 `DB_PATH.parent`，用户在设置页改了数据目录，互斥域随之改变 —— 这正是
   我们想要的语义：**共享同一个库才需要互斥**，指向不同目录的两个实例可以共存。

判活/杀进程全部走 win_proc，不用 tasklist+text=True（那条路在 UTF-8 模式下会
静默失效，见 win_proc 模块头）。

functions.doc: 杀掉旧后端整棵树，并等端口真的松开。

functions.name: _start_parent_watchdog
functions.doc:
Electron 一死就自杀，从根上消灭孤儿。

为什么用 wait_pid_exit 而不是轮询：
  Windows 上它走 OpenProcess + WaitForSingleObject，等的是**内核对象**而不是
  PID 号。句柄在整个等待期间持有，所以 PID 被复用也不会误触发 —— 这比
  「定期检查 pid 还在不在」既准又省电（毫秒级响应，零轮询）。

functions.name: _suicide
functions.doc:
父进程没了 → 收干净自己的子进程再退出。

⛔ 用 os._exit 而不是 sys.exit：这里在非主线程里，sys.exit 只会结束本线程，
   主线程照样在 event loop 里跑 —— 孤儿依旧是孤儿。
   os._exit 前必须手动做清理，因为它不跑 atexit / lifespan shutdown。

functions.name: _try_take_lock
functions.doc:
抢本数据目录的独占锁。拿到返回 True，已被别人持有返回 False。

为什么在 pid 文件之外还要一把真锁：
    pid 文件是「读—判断—写」三步，两个实例同一秒启动时会双双读到空文件、
    双双判定"没人占位"、双双写入 —— 后写的覆盖前写的，**两个都放行**。
    结果是两个后端同时 resume 同一批工作流（WAL 不报错，只是静默把产物搅乱）。
    单实例锁只挡同一个 appId，国内版 + 国际版是两个 appId，而它们默认共用
    %APPDATA%\MHAgent 这同一个数据目录，所以这个竞态是真会发生的。

为什么用文件锁而不是"再检查一遍"：
    操作系统在进程**死亡时自动释放**文件锁。所以"锁还被持有"这个事实本身就
    证明持有者活着 —— 崩溃、被强杀、断电都不会留下陈旧锁，不需要任何超时或
    心跳去判断锁是否失效。这是 pid 文件给不了的保证。

functions.name: acquire
functions.doc:
占用本数据目录的后端席位。

- 上一个后端是孤儿（父进程已死）→ 杀掉它，自己上。
- 上一个后端活着且它的 Electron 也活着且端口有响应 → 抛 AlreadyRunning。
- 上一个后端活着但端口没响应（卡死/正在退出）→ 杀掉它，自己上。
  这条是刻意的：用户对"卡住了就重启一下"有预期，不能把人锁在门外。
- 记录陈旧 → 直接占用。

classes.name: Decimal
classes.doc:
Construct a new Decimal object. 'value' can be an integer, string, tuple,
or another Decimal object. If no value is given, return Decimal('0'). The
context does not affect the conversion and is only passed to determine if
the InvalidOperation trap is active.

methods.name: adjusted
methods.doc: Return the adjusted exponent of the number.  Defined as exp + digits - 1.

methods.name: as_integer_ratio
methods.doc:
Decimal.as_integer_ratio() -> (int, int)

Return a pair of integers, whose ratio is exactly equal to the original
Decimal and with a positive denominator. The ratio is in lowest terms.
Raise OverflowError on infinities and a ValueError on NaNs.

methods.name: as_tuple
methods.doc: Return a tuple representation of the number.

methods.name: canonical
methods.doc:
Return the canonical encoding of the argument.  Currently, the encoding
of a Decimal instance is always canonical, so this operation returns its
argument unchanged.

methods.name: compare
methods.doc:
Compare self to other.  Return a decimal value:

a or b is a NaN ==> Decimal('NaN')
a < b           ==> Decimal('-1')
a == b          ==> Decimal('0')
a > b           ==> Decimal('1')

methods.name: compare_signal
methods.doc: Identical to compare, except that all NaNs signal.

methods.name: compare_total
methods.doc:
Compare two operands using their abstract representation rather than
their numerical value.  Similar to the compare() method, but the result
gives a total ordering on Decimal instances.  Two Decimal instances with
the same numeric value but different representations compare unequal
in this ordering:

    >>> Decimal('12.0').compare_total(Decimal('12'))
    Decimal('-1')

Quiet and signaling NaNs are also included in the total ordering. The result
of this function is Decimal('0') if both operands have the same representation,
Decimal('-1') if the first operand is lower in the total order than the second,
and Decimal('1') if the first operand is higher in the total order than the
second operand. See the specification for details of the total order.

This operation is unaffected by context and is quiet: no flags are changed
and no rounding is performed. As an exception, the C version may raise
InvalidOperation if the second operand cannot be converted exactly.

methods.name: compare_total_mag
methods.doc:
Compare two operands using their abstract representation rather than their
value as in compare_total(), but ignoring the sign of each operand.

x.compare_total_mag(y) is equivalent to x.copy_abs().compare_total(y.copy_abs()).

This operation is unaffected by context and is quiet: no flags are changed
and no rounding is performed. As an exception, the C version may raise
InvalidOperation if the second operand cannot be converted exactly.

methods.name: conjugate
methods.doc: Return self.

methods.name: copy_abs
methods.doc:
Return the absolute value of the argument.  This operation is unaffected by
context and is quiet: no flags are changed and no rounding is performed.

methods.name: copy_negate
methods.doc:
Return the negation of the argument.  This operation is unaffected by context
and is quiet: no flags are changed and no rounding is performed.

methods.name: copy_sign
methods.doc:
Return a copy of the first operand with the sign set to be the same as the
sign of the second operand. For example:

    >>> Decimal('2.3').copy_sign(Decimal('-1.5'))
    Decimal('-2.3')

This operation is unaffected by context and is quiet: no flags are changed
and no rounding is performed. As an exception, the C version may raise
InvalidOperation if the second operand cannot be converted exactly.

methods.name: exp
methods.doc:
Return the value of the (natural) exponential function e**x at the given
number.  The function always uses the ROUND_HALF_EVEN mode and the result
is correctly rounded.

methods.name: fma
methods.doc:
Fused multiply-add.  Return self*other+third with no rounding of the
intermediate product self*other.

    >>> Decimal(2).fma(3, 5)
    Decimal('11')

methods.name: from_float
methods.doc:
Class method that converts a float to a decimal number, exactly.
Since 0.1 is not exactly representable in binary floating point,
Decimal.from_float(0.1) is not the same as Decimal('0.1').

    >>> Decimal.from_float(0.1)
    Decimal('0.1000000000000000055511151231257827021181583404541015625')
    >>> Decimal.from_float(float('nan'))
    Decimal('NaN')
    >>> Decimal.from_float(float('inf'))
    Decimal('Infinity')
    >>> Decimal.from_float(float('-inf'))
    Decimal('-Infinity')

methods.name: is_canonical
methods.doc:
Return True if the argument is canonical and False otherwise.  Currently,
a Decimal instance is always canonical, so this operation always returns
True.

methods.name: is_finite
methods.doc:
Return True if the argument is a finite number, and False if the argument
is infinite or a NaN.

methods.name: is_infinite
methods.doc:
Return True if the argument is either positive or negative infinity and
False otherwise.

methods.name: is_nan
methods.doc:
Return True if the argument is a (quiet or signaling) NaN and False
otherwise.

methods.name: is_normal
methods.doc:
Return True if the argument is a normal finite non-zero number with an
adjusted exponent greater than or equal to Emin. Return False if the
argument is zero, subnormal, infinite or a NaN.

methods.name: is_qnan
methods.doc: Return True if the argument is a quiet NaN, and False otherwise.

methods.name: is_signed
methods.doc:
Return True if the argument has a negative sign and False otherwise.
Note that both zeros and NaNs can carry signs.

methods.name: is_snan
methods.doc: Return True if the argument is a signaling NaN and False otherwise.

methods.name: is_subnormal
methods.doc:
Return True if the argument is subnormal, and False otherwise. A number is
subnormal if it is non-zero, finite, and has an adjusted exponent less
than Emin.

methods.name: is_zero
methods.doc:
Return True if the argument is a (positive or negative) zero and False
otherwise.

methods.name: ln
methods.doc:
Return the natural (base e) logarithm of the operand. The function always
uses the ROUND_HALF_EVEN mode and the result is correctly rounded.

methods.name: log10
methods.doc:
Return the base ten logarithm of the operand. The function always uses the
ROUND_HALF_EVEN mode and the result is correctly rounded.

methods.name: logb
methods.doc:
For a non-zero number, return the adjusted exponent of the operand as a
Decimal instance.  If the operand is a zero, then Decimal('-Infinity') is
returned and the DivisionByZero condition is raised. If the operand is
an infinity then Decimal('Infinity') is returned.

methods.name: logical_and
methods.doc: Return the digit-wise 'and' of the two (logical) operands.

methods.name: logical_invert
methods.doc: Return the digit-wise inversion of the (logical) operand.

methods.name: logical_or
methods.doc: Return the digit-wise 'or' of the two (logical) operands.

methods.name: logical_xor
methods.doc: Return the digit-wise 'exclusive or' of the two (logical) operands.

methods.name: max
methods.doc:
Maximum of self and other.  If one operand is a quiet NaN and the other is
numeric, the numeric operand is returned.

methods.name: max_mag
methods.doc:
Similar to the max() method, but the comparison is done using the absolute
values of the operands.

methods.name: min
methods.doc:
Minimum of self and other. If one operand is a quiet NaN and the other is
numeric, the numeric operand is returned.

methods.name: min_mag
methods.doc:
Similar to the min() method, but the comparison is done using the absolute
values of the operands.

methods.name: next_minus
methods.doc:
Return the largest number representable in the given context (or in the
current default context if no context is given) that is smaller than the
given operand.

methods.name: next_plus
methods.doc:
Return the smallest number representable in the given context (or in the
current default context if no context is given) that is larger than the
given operand.

methods.name: next_toward
methods.doc:
If the two operands are unequal, return the number closest to the first
operand in the direction of the second operand.  If both operands are
numerically equal, return a copy of the first operand with the sign set
to be the same as the sign of the second operand.

methods.name: normalize
methods.doc:
Normalize the number by stripping the rightmost trailing zeros and
converting any result equal to Decimal('0') to Decimal('0e0').  Used
for producing canonical values for members of an equivalence class.
For example, Decimal('32.100') and Decimal('0.321000e+2') both normalize
to the equivalent value Decimal('32.1').

methods.name: number_class
methods.doc:
Return a string describing the class of the operand.  The returned value
is one of the following ten strings:

    * '-Infinity', indicating that the operand is negative infinity.
    * '-Normal', indicating that the operand is a negative normal number.
    * '-Subnormal', indicating that the operand is negative and subnormal.
    * '-Zero', indicating that the operand is a negative zero.
    * '+Zero', indicating that the operand is a positive zero.
    * '+Subnormal', indicating that the operand is positive and subnormal.
    * '+Normal', indicating that the operand is a positive normal number.
    * '+Infinity', indicating that the operand is positive infinity.
    * 'NaN', indicating that the operand is a quiet NaN (Not a Number).
    * 'sNaN', indicating that the operand is a signaling NaN.

methods.name: quantize
methods.doc:
Return a value equal to the first operand after rounding and having the
exponent of the second operand.

    >>> Decimal('1.41421356').quantize(Decimal('1.000'))
    Decimal('1.414')

Unlike other operations, if the length of the coefficient after the quantize
operation would be greater than precision, then an InvalidOperation is signaled.
This guarantees that, unless there is an error condition, the quantized exponent
is always equal to that of the right-hand operand.

Also unlike other operations, quantize never signals Underflow, even if the
result is subnormal and inexact.

If the exponent of the second operand is larger than that of the first, then
rounding may be necessary. In this case, the rounding mode is determined by the
rounding argument if given, else by the given context argument; if neither
argument is given, the rounding mode of the current thread's context is used.

methods.name: radix
methods.doc:
Return Decimal(10), the radix (base) in which the Decimal class does
all its arithmetic. Included for compatibility with the specification.

methods.name: remainder_near
methods.doc:
Return the remainder from dividing self by other.  This differs from
self % other in that the sign of the remainder is chosen so as to minimize
its absolute value. More precisely, the return value is self - n * other
where n is the integer nearest to the exact value of self / other, and
if two integers are equally near then the even one is chosen.

If the result is zero then its sign will be the sign of self.

methods.name: rotate
methods.doc:
Return the result of rotating the digits of the first operand by an amount
specified by the second operand.  The second operand must be an integer in
the range -precision through precision. The absolute value of the second
operand gives the number of places to rotate. If the second operand is
positive then rotation is to the left; otherwise rotation is to the right.
The coefficient of the first operand is padded on the left with zeros to
length precision if necessary. The sign and exponent of the first operand are
unchanged.

methods.name: same_quantum
methods.doc:
Test whether self and other have the same exponent or whether both are NaN.

This operation is unaffected by context and is quiet: no flags are changed
and no rounding is performed. As an exception, the C version may raise
InvalidOperation if the second operand cannot be converted exactly.

methods.name: scaleb
methods.doc:
Return the first operand with the exponent adjusted the second.  Equivalently,
return the first operand multiplied by 10**other. The second operand must be
an integer.

methods.name: shift
methods.doc:
Return the result of shifting the digits of the first operand by an amount
specified by the second operand.  The second operand must be an integer in
the range -precision through precision. The absolute value of the second
operand gives the number of places to shift. If the second operand is
positive, then the shift is to the left; otherwise the shift is to the
right. Digits shifted into the coefficient are zeros. The sign and exponent
of the first operand are unchanged.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.doc:
Return the square root of the argument to full precision. The result is
correctly rounded using the ROUND_HALF_EVEN rounding mode.

methods.name: to_eng_string
methods.doc:
Convert to an engineering-type string.  Engineering notation has an exponent
which is a multiple of 3, so there are up to 3 digits left of the decimal
place. For example, Decimal('123E+1') is converted to Decimal('1.23E+3').

The value of context.capitals determines whether the exponent sign is lower
or upper case. Otherwise, the context does not affect the operation.

methods.name: to_integral
methods.doc:
Identical to the to_integral_value() method.  The to_integral() name has been
kept for compatibility with older versions.

methods.name: to_integral_exact
methods.doc:
Round to the nearest integer, signaling Inexact or Rounded as appropriate if
rounding occurs.  The rounding mode is determined by the rounding parameter
if given, else by the given context. If neither parameter is given, then the
rounding mode of the current default context is used.

methods.name: to_integral_value
methods.doc:
Round to the nearest integer without signaling Inexact or Rounded.  The
rounding mode is determined by the rounding parameter if given, else by
the given context. If neither parameter is given, then the rounding mode
of the current default context is used.

methods.name: _model_limit_matches
methods.doc:
Match the one-model token policy across New API wire formats.

New API stores ``model_limits`` as text, while different releases have
returned the same value with surrounding whitespace, a trailing comma,
or (for some response serializers) a one-item JSON array.  The client
must tolerate those representation-only differences without widening
the policy: exactly one non-empty model name must remain, and it must
equal the requested model.  A multi-model value is deliberately not
accepted here.

methods.name: _scoped_token_name
methods.doc:
Derive a bounded, deterministic provider token name for one task.

The name must separate every credential this login may hold at the same
time.  Two dimensions are required:

``scope``
    Distinct workflows/steps run concurrently.  Sharing one name lets a
    starting task rotate (delete) a running task's credential, which
    the provider then rejects as an invalid token mid-run.
``model``
    Each token is created with ``model_limits`` for exactly one model.
    The main call, an auxiliary call and image generation legitimately
    ask for different models, sometimes with no workflow scope at all.
    Without this dimension they collide on one name, and every request
    finds the other's model restriction "wrong" and recreates the
    token, so two callers permanently revoke each other.

methods.name: _tokens_for_login
methods.doc:
Return only tokens issued by this Modex login.

Scoped workflow tokens use ``<login-name>-wf-<sha256-prefix>``.  The
login name is random, so filtering by this exact prefix cannot select
an unrelated user-created token.

methods.name: from_payload
methods.doc:
classmethod(function) -> method

Convert a function to be a class method.

A class method receives the class as implicit first argument,
just like an instance method receives the instance.
To declare a class method, use this idiom:

  class C:
      @classmethod
      def f(cls, arg1, arg2, argN):
          ...

It can be called either on the class (e.g. C.f()) or on an instance
(e.g. C().f()).  The instance is ignored except for its class.
If a class method is called for a derived class, the derived class
object is passed as the implied first argument.

Class methods are different than C++ or Java static methods.
If you want those, see the staticmethod builtin.

functions.name: decrypt_package_files_to_directory

Atomically materialize only explicitly approved files from a package.

``shared-scripts`` is intentionally a single License package for backwards
compatibility.  Callers must therefore avoid expanding the whole package
merely because they possess its short-lived DEK.  This helper applies a
strict, caller-supplied file allowlist and swaps the completed directory in
one operation, so a failed decrypt never leaves a half-populated ``_utils``.

The selected paths are relative to ``source`` and refer to their plaintext
names (for example ``plot_utils.py`` rather than ``plot_utils.py.enc``).
Empty selections are rejected: callers that only need ``__init__.py`` can
create that public marker without requesting a content key.

操作"，不是"论文没通过检查"的证据。
⛔ 也不能并进 ``checker_unavailable``：那个判定被多处用来决定"要不要返修"，

services.project_server.doc:
一句话生成项目 —— 本地服务启动/停止/状态管理。

给用户生成的项目(code/)起前端(vite dev)/后端(uvicorn)服务，供浏览器预览。
与 claude_runner 不同：这里的进程是**常驻服务**(不会自己结束)，无 inactivity 超时，
由用户主动启停，并在工作流删除/后端退出/端口段兜底三处清理，防进程泄漏。

关键防坑（见调研结论）：
- Windows 下 node 会 fork vite/esbuild 子进程，停止必须 taskkill /T 杀整树。
- SIGKILL 时清理钩子不跑，靠"启动前清端口段"兜底。
- 端口用固定段 19000-19100，与主后端(18088)隔开。

methods.name: verify
methods.doc:
classmethod(function) -> method

Convert a function to be a class method.

A class method receives the class as implicit first argument,
just like an instance method receives the instance.
To declare a class method, use this idiom:

  class C:
      @classmethod
      def f(cls, arg1, arg2, argN):
          ...

It can be called either on the class (e.g. C.f()) or on an instance
(e.g. C().f()).  The instance is ignored except for its class.
If a class method is called for a derived class, the derived class
object is passed as the implied first argument.

Class methods are different than C++ or Java static methods.
If you want those, see the staticmethod builtin.

functions.name: decrypt_package_files_to_directory
functions.doc:
Atomically materialize only explicitly approved files from a package.

``shared-scripts`` is intentionally a single License package for backwards
compatibility.  Callers must therefore avoid expanding the whole package
merely because they possess its short-lived DEK.  This helper applies a
strict, caller-supplied file allowlist and swaps the completed directory in
one operation, so a failed decrypt never leaves a half-populated ``_utils``.

The selected paths are relative to ``source`` and refer to their plaintext
names (for example ``plot_utils.py`` rather than ``plot_utils.py.enc``).
Empty selections are rejected: callers that only need ``__init__.py`` can
create that public marker without requesting a content key.

services.skill_mcp.doc:
MCP server：按后端当前工作流计划提供可提议的能力与文件契约。

⛔⛔⛔ 本文件是【独立进程】，由 Claude CLI 派生（--mcp-config 指定）。
   它跟后端不在同一个进程里，所以：
   · 不能 import 后端模块（services.* 那些）—— 导进来是另一份内存，队列/票据都对不上
   · 只能通过 HTTP 回调 /api/internal/chat/*，凭短票鉴权
   · 不持有 MODEX_CONTROL_TOKEN（那等于把整个后端 API 的钥匙交给子进程）

协议：stdio + 手写 JSON-RPC，照 mcp-servers/llm-chat/server.py 的写法
（仓库里 4 个现成 MCP server 都是这个模式，没用 SDK，避免多一个依赖）。

⛔ 为什么 propose_skill 立刻返回而不等执行完：
   MCP 是请求-响应协议，comp-code 要跑 32 分钟，客户端等不到就超时。
   所以这里只创建提议记录 + 广播卡片，真正执行走后端自己的串行队列。
   返回文案必须明说"这是正常流程，不要重试"—— 实测（Phase 0）加了这句之后
   主会话只调一次就停下，不加的话它可能以为失败了反复重试。

环境变量（由 chat_session.py 注入）：
   MODEX_CHAT_TICKET      短票
   MODEX_CHAT_SESSION_ID  会话 id
   MODEX_CHAT_WORKFLOW_ID 工作流 id
   MODEX_CHAT_API_BASE    后端地址，如 http://127.0.0.1:8765

The caller must use a fresh connection.  ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` serializes
heartbeat/startup workers even when a stale deployment accidentally leaves
two backend processes pointing at the same SQLite database.  Only a worker
that successfully increments the durable counter may create a new task.

``init_db``; a normal heartbeat may only claim a currently-running row.

Reset durable automatic-recovery guard after an explicit user action.

This is deliberately a separate helper so callers can keep the reset in

fixture has no migration columns, leave its behavior unchanged; production
databases are migrated by :func:`init_db` before any workflow can start.

Atomically save a preset and an explicitly requested shared policy.

Omitted context_mode is the old-client contract: leave the policy bytes

read-modify-write outside the transaction. A deleted edit target is never

functions.name: finish_local_operation
functions.doc:
Keep the workspace lock until a non-cancellable worker stops writing.

Cancelling asyncio.to_thread does not stop the thread. Deferring the
cancellation prevents pause/restart from launching a second export while
the first converter is still writing the same file.

functions.name: recover_checked_step
functions.sig: (*, check: 'Callable[[], Awaitable[list[CheckIssue]]]', repair: 'Callable[[str, int], Awaitable[None]]', snapshot: 'Callable[[], object]', progress: 'Callable[[str, str], Awaitable[None]]', cancelled: 'Callable[[], bool]', max_repairs: 'int' = 3, max_local_rechecks: 'int' = 2, max_advisory_repairs: 'int' = 1) -> 'int'
functions.doc:
Recheck *all* gates after each targeted repair; return actual repairs.

Cancellation, unavailable checkers and unsafe runner failures propagate.
A first unchanged repair gets one fresh diagnostic attempt; a second
unchanged repair stops. A changed reason is progress even without edits.
Advisory-only findings get a separate best-effort budget, never consume
hard repair attempts and never prevent completion on their own. Any hard
defect introduced by optimization must pass the same checks again.
Unresolved blocking issues never become successful execution.

services.win_proc.doc:
Windows 进程工具：判活、创建时间、杀进程树、控制台输出解码。

为什么单独抽一个模块（三个踩过的坑）：

1) **`text=True` 在 UTF-8 模式下会炸。**
   桌面端启动后端时带了 `PYTHONUTF8=1`（main.js env）和 `-X utf8`（打包模式
   argv），于是 `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` 用 UTF-8 去解 Windows 命令吐出
   的 **GBK** 中文，直接抛：
       UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xb4 in position 0
   （`b4 ed` 正是 GBK 的「错」字，taskkill/tasklist 报错都以「错误:」开头。）
   更阴的是它炸在 subprocess 的 `_readerthread` 子线程里 —— 主线程只拿到空
   stdout，**不会抛异常**。于是 `_alive()` 把活着的进程判成「已死」，孤儿回收
   逻辑静默失效，用户侧表现成「端口一直被占，重启也没用」。
   所以：**一律拿 bytes 自己解**，永不用 text=True / encoding=。

2) **`wmic` 在 Win11 上没了。** 24H2 起 WMIC 已从默认功能移除，
   `FileNotFoundError`。改用 Windows API，PowerShell 只作最后兜底（慢，~300ms）。

3) **`tasklist` 判活不可靠且慢。** 除了编码问题，它还受 AV 拦截、输出被本地化
   影响。改用 `OpenProcess` + `WaitForSingleObject`，纯 API、无子进程、微秒级。

functions.name: _open_process
functions.doc: OpenProcess 包装。返回 (handle, last_error)；handle 为 None 表示没开成。

functions.name: decode_console
functions.doc:
解码 Windows 控制台输出，绝不抛异常。

顺序：本地代码页(mbcs/GBK) → UTF-8 → latin-1 兜底。
中文系统上 cmd 工具输出的是本地代码页(cp936)，不是 UTF-8。

functions.name: kill_descendants
functions.doc:
Kill descendants left behind after one of our root processes exits.

``taskkill /T`` only works reliably while the root PID still exists.  A
shell or solver can outlive a normally exiting Claude CLI process, after
which unregistering the root loses the only durable cleanup evidence.  We
take one process-table snapshot, follow only the recorded parent-PID tree,
and verify every candidate's creation time immediately before killing it.
No process-name matching is used, so the user's own Claude/Python programs
are outside the scope.

functions.name: kill_tree
functions.doc: 杀掉进程及其整棵子树。返回是否认为已经死了。

functions.name: pid_alive
functions.doc:
进程是否还活着。Windows 走纯 API，不起子进程。

⛔ 用 WaitForSingleObject 而不是 GetExitCodeProcess：后者用 STILL_ACTIVE(259)
   表示「还在跑」，可真进程若以 259 为退出码退出就会被误判成活着。
   WaitForSingleObject(h, 0) 没这个二义性。

functions.name: proc_create_time
functions.doc:
进程创建时间（Unix 秒），用于识别 PID 复用。拿不到返回 None。

优先级：psutil → Win32 GetProcessTimes → PowerShell。
⛔ 不再用 wmic —— Win11 24H2 起已从系统移除。

functions.name: run_console
functions.doc:
跑一条命令，返回 (returncode, 已解码的 stdout+stderr)。

绝不用 text=True —— 见模块头坑 1。命令不存在/超时都不抛，返回 (-1, 说明)。

functions.name: same_process
functions.doc:
pid 现在还是当初登记的那个进程吗（防 PID 复用）。

want_create_time 为 None（当初没取到）时只能凭存活判断 —— 这是已知的
降级路径，调用方需要自己权衡是否敢杀。

functions.name: wait_pid_exit
functions.doc:
阻塞等某个进程退出。Windows 用内核对象等待（不轮询、毫秒级响应）。

timeout=None 表示无限等。返回 True=已退出，False=超时还活着。

services.workbench_access.doc:
Local workbench admission, deliberately separate from paid execution.

The account branch allows only the reviewed local-data and task route/method pairs below.
Never replace this with an /api prefix or all-GET exemption: execution can also
hide behind GET, and newly added routes must remain denied until reviewed.

functions.name: _route_path
functions.doc:
Normalize only the harmless trailing slash before exact route checks.

Some reverse proxies preserve a user-entered trailing slash while the
FastAPI route itself is registered without one.  Treating those two forms
differently made an otherwise reviewed account action fall through to the
generic ``ACCOUNT_EXECUTION_NOT_ENABLED`` response.  Do not collapse
repeated slashes or decode/strip other path material: the allowlist must
remain exact and fail closed.

functions.name: requires_realname_action
functions.doc: Only new AI work. Stop, history, local editing and recovery stay open.

functions.name: workbench_access

services.workflow_acceptance.doc:
Small, deterministic delivery checks, without length/formula-count quotas.

These checks establish usable core output, not mathematical correctness or a

functions.name: core_file_problem

functions.name: has_report_content
functions.doc:
Accept concise prose, tables and useful lists, but not headings/TODOs.

Full-line matching is intentional: a real report can discuss TODO entries
or quote the word 'placeholder' without becoming an empty-shell report.

functions.name: unfinished_sections
functions.doc:
Only empty/explicitly unfinished active chapters warrant continuation.

Short valid chapters and unused drafts are not incomplete work. Before
main.tex exists, the current plan can still identify missing draft files.
Missing inputs in an assembled paper remain the compiler's responsibility.

functions.doc:
解析某步「真实生效」的 executor model_id，用于落库快照（前端历史回看）。
step_model 指定了 model_id → 用它；否则回退全局 executor 角色的最终 model_id。
任何异常都吞掉返回空串，绝不因为「记个快照」把执行搞崩。

functions.name: _artifact_progress_signature
functions.doc:
Return a content signature for declared artifacts only.

Diagnostic reports and logs are deliberately excluded: rewriting a check
report is not progress toward a missing paper, result file, or figure.
Timestamps are deliberately excluded too: an agent that rewrites identical
content has made no repair progress and must not earn another paid retry.

functions.name: _await_recovery
functions.doc:
An outer deadline must preserve the same recovery classification.

wait_for cancels and joins the child. _run_recovery_skill cancels its own
CLI before propagating that cancellation, so no duplicate job is started.

functions.name: _build_context_summary
functions.doc:
读取工作区已有文件的内容摘要，供给 Claude 参考。
优先读取关键类型文件（md/tex/bib），并做字符预算。

functions.name: _check_data_figure_quality
functions.doc: Check source text budget first, then the PDFs that users will see.

functions.name: _check_figure_pdf_quality
functions.doc:
Run the deterministic PDF visual gate for the requested figure subset.

The model saying that a chart "looks fine" is not evidence.  This guard
inspects the files that actually landed in ``figures/`` and runs locally,
so it adds no model calls or token cost.  ``candidates`` may contain source
names, PNG paths or PDF paths; only corresponding existing PDFs are passed
to the checker.  A PNG-only Word workflow is therefore left compatible.

functions.name: _check_figures_step_health
functions.sig: (workspace: 'Path', skill_name: 'str', files_created: 'Optional[List[str]]', files_modified: 'Optional[List[str]]', params: 'Dict[str, Any]') -> 'Tuple[bool, str]'
functions.doc:
对图表步骤做严格健康检查(动态版, 基于本步骤的文件增量)。

Returns: (ok, reason)
    ok=True: 步骤产出健康(有真实新增图 / 用户禁用 / 无图论文场景 / rerun-skip 合法跳过)
    ok=False: 步骤摸鱼了, 应触发 AUTO-RECOVER

判定规则:
    - paper-figure / nature-figure / experiment-bridge: 必须有「数据类」新增图
      (排除 drawio/tikz 前缀, 因为那些是 paper-figure-drawio 的产出)
      ⛔ 例外: figures/ 已有该步骤应有的「数据类」图 + 本步骤未新增任何文件
              → 视为 rerun 时 SKILL 的「恢复检查」让 Claude 合法跳过, 放行
    - paper-figure-drawio: 必须有「架构图类」新增图(drawio 前缀或 tikz_)
      ⛔ 例外同上: figures/ 已有架构图 + 本步骤无新增 → 合法跳过
    - 用户开关 skip_figures/skip_drawio: 直接放行(理论上前置已跳过, 防御性)
    - PAPER_PLAN.md 声明无图表: 放行(纯文字论文场景)

functions.name: _check_figures_step_health_static
functions.doc:
图表步骤健康检查(静态版, 不依赖 files_created)。

用于崩溃恢复 / waiting_checkpoint 等无法获取增量的场景。
退化为「figures/ 下当前是否存在该步骤应有的图类」。

functions.name: _check_paper_body_pages
functions.doc:
按竞赛页数语义做保守的正文字符预检。

正文定义：
- LaTeX 模式：`paper/sections/*.tex` 总字符数
- Word 模式：`paper/main.md` 中"## 附录"之前的部分
- 中文 chars_per_page ≈ 800（含图表），英文 ≈ 2200

Returns: (ok: bool, reason: str)

functions.name: _check_step_companions
functions.doc:
检查二级文件是否齐全. 返回 (ok: bool, missing: List[str]).

每个文件要求:
    - 文件存在
    - 文件大小 > 50 字节 (防空文件占位)

functions.name: _classify_manifest_by_sections
functions.doc:
按 FIGURE_MANIFEST 的章节标题把图名归类(权威, 优先于文件名前缀)。

manifest 三章节标题形如(paper-plan/SKILL.md 约定):
    **数据图（matplotlib gen_fig_*.py，paper-figure 产出 .png/.pdf）：**
    **DrawIO 流程/架构图（paper-figure-drawio 产出 .drawio + .png/.pdf）：**
    **TikZ 图（paper-figure 产出 tikz_*.pdf）：**

归属按「哪个步骤产出」决定, 与健康检查的步骤对账口径一致:
    · 数据图章节              → data_figs   (paper-figure 产出)
    · DrawIO/HTML 章节 + TikZ 章节 → drawio_figs (paper-figure-drawio/-html 产出)

⛔ 只认 ** 粗体章节标题里的关键词, 不看图名前缀 —— 这样
   fig_data_pipeline/fig_model_arch 这类「关键词在中间」的架构图不会被误判。

识别不到规范章节结构(无章节标题, 或有图名落在任何章节之前)时返回 ([], []),
交由调用方 fallback 到前缀分类。

functions.name: _comp_en_steps
functions.doc: 返回英文竞赛通用步骤列表。

functions.name: _comp_zh_steps
functions.doc:
返回中文竞赛通用步骤列表。

Most Chinese competitions share the same writing contract.  Huawei Cup is
the deliberate exception: it has its own graduate-level mechanism and
solver-depth Skill, so callers can select it without duplicating the DAG.

functions.name: _compress_claude_md
functions.doc:
空工具调用智能恢复：压缩 CLAUDE.md 中的图片描述和冗余内容，减少 prompt 大小。

典型场景：paper-figure 步骤运行时上下文累积到 110K tokens，导致 Claude 输出被截断。
压缩策略：
1. 图片描述截断为摘要（每张图最多 100 字）
2. 文档原文截断（每个文档最多 500 字）
3. 删除重复的规则段落

functions.name: _compute_health_blocks
functions.doc: Edits alone never substitute for mandatory computation outputs.

functions.doc:
检查 names 中有多少个图已经实际产出 (任意 .png/.pdf/.drawio 都算)。

Returns: (产出数, 缺失的名字列表)

functions.doc:
扫描工作区中的图片文件，用 vision LLM 描述内容，追加到 CLAUDE.md 正文中。

workflow_id 可选：传了就把识别进度推到前端日志区（这一步也跑在步骤循环之前，
不推就是一段静默）。不传则退化成原行为，不影响其它调用方。

functions.name: _extract_pdf_with_vision
functions.doc: Bounded, source-versioned OCR; partial results are never called complete.

functions.name: _generate_claude_md
functions.doc: 在工作区生成 CLAUDE.md，为 Claude CLI 提供项目上下文。

functions.name: _has_vision_extraction
functions.doc: Whether this exact workspace PDF already has a usable vision transcript.

functions.name: _health_requires_repair
functions.sig: (workspace, skill_name, primary, health_ok, reason, quality_failure, files_created=(), files_modified=()) -> 'bool'
functions.doc:
Never let auxiliary changes override deterministic missing artifacts.

Retain the prior advisory treatment of size/page heuristics; they are not
authority to rewrite a correct manuscript. Explicit figure, computation,
companion, checker and submission failures cannot be converted to success.

functions.name: _inject_once
functions.doc:
幂等地把 content 追加到 CLAUDE.md。

通过 marker 检测是否已注入过。重跑步骤、心跳自愈、崩溃恢复等场景下
避免重复追加同一段提示导致上下文污染。

用法（替代 with open(claude_md, "a") as f: f.write(text)）：
    _inject_once(claude_md, "INJECT_PLAN_GUIDANCE", notes_text)

Args:
    claude_md: CLAUDE.md 文件路径
    marker: 唯一标识（建议大写 + 下划线，如 "INJECT_DOCX_TABLE_RULES"）
    content: 要追加的内容（marker 会自动包装在 HTML 注释里）

Returns:
    True 表示真的写入了；False 表示已存在 marker，跳过。

functions.name: _is_drawio_fig
functions.doc: 判断 figures/ 下的文件路径是否属于 drawio/tikz 架构图类。

functions.name: _mark_active_step_failed
functions.doc:
Atomically terminate the workflow and every active step.

Runner setup can fail before a Claude subprocess exists (for example a
Capsule/runtime mismatch).  Historically the outer exception handler only
marked ``workflows`` failed, leaving ``workflow_steps`` permanently
``running`` with no durable reason.  Keep both tables and the audit log in a
single transaction so the UI can never observe that split-brain terminal
state after the commit.

functions.name: _mark_workflow_preparing
functions.doc:
Expose real pre-step work during start and crash recovery.

``init_db`` first normalizes interrupted workflows to ``paused``.  The
recreated task can then spend minutes extracting documents or calling
Vision before a Skill starts.  Persisting this state immediately prevents
the dashboard and durable log from presenting that live work as idle.

functions.name: _min_size_for
functions.doc:
获取该 skill 的 primary_output 最低字节阈值, 默认 100。

primary_output: 该步骤实际的主产物路径。docx 模式下改进循环的产物是
`paper/main.md`(Markdown), 而非默认的 50KB PDF, 用 PDF 阈值会误判失败,
因此对 markdown 产物使用更合理的下限。

functions.name: _needs_pdf_vision
functions.doc:
Return false for a good cache or a recent transient all-page failure.

Successful OCR is reused indefinitely while its transcript exists.  A full
fallback is retried after a short cooldown, and replacing the source PDF
invalidates the cooldown immediately through the source signature.

functions.name: _notify_vision
functions.doc:
推一条预处理进度到前端日志区。

⛔ 只吞 Exception，不能写成 except BaseException / 裸 except：CancelledError 继承自
BaseException，一旦在这里被吞掉，用户点暂停就对整个 vision 阶段失效了。
推送失败本身无所谓 —— 前端还有 5~8 秒轮询兜底。

functions.name: _paper_submission_report
functions.doc: Prefer the gate run inside ClaudeRunner's authenticated utility scope.

functions.name: _pause_for_access_mode
functions.doc: Startup recovery must not relabel unavailable billing as model failure.

functions.name: _pause_for_check
functions.doc: Commit step/workflow/diagnostic together before broadcasting a pause.

functions.name: _pause_for_protected_content
functions.doc:
Persist a safe Skill/License preparation diagnostic before pausing.

Packaged clients used to clear ``error_message`` here and only emit the
``workflow_license_required`` event.  Re-opening the workflow therefore
showed a blank pending card, and clicking Continue immediately hit the
same Capsule/License condition again.  Keep the pause fail-closed, but
make the reason durable and actionable.  No plaintext Skill or provider
credential is copied into the workflow record.

functions.name: _pdf_vision_state_path
functions.doc: Internal retry ledger; deliberately excluded from public artifacts.

functions.name: _pdf_vision_targets
functions.doc:
Return the deterministic PDF set shared by automatic and chat modes.

The explicitly selected problem statement is always included.  A small
number of ordinary PDF attachments are also included, matching the legacy
automatic-workflow policy without letting a large reference library trigger
unbounded vision calls.

functions.name: _pfa_safety_copy_assets
functions.doc:
paper_from_assets 兜底: 把 user_data/ 里的资产复制到工作目录的标准位置。

assets-inventory skill 的 SKILL.md 里会要求 Claude 自己复制文件,
但万一 Claude 漏了某些文件, 这里做引擎层兜底, 确保:
- user_data/*.py / *.ipynb / *.zip → code/
- user_data/*.csv / *.xlsx / *.tsv / *.json → data/ (排除 results.json)
- user_data/*.png / *.jpg / *.jpeg / *.svg → figures/user_fig_*
- user_data/*.tex / *.cls / *.sty / *.docx / *.dotx → _user_templates/

返回复制统计 dict, 用于注入提示。

幂等: 同名文件已存在则跳过。

functions.name: _plan_says_no_figures
functions.doc:
检查 PAPER_PLAN.md / PROBLEM_ANALYSIS.md / TOPIC_PLAN.md 是否声明本论文无图表
(纯文字综述/思辨论文场景)。

functions.name: _post_edit_issues
functions.sig: (workspace, skill_name, primary, template, params, changed, *, progress, cancelled)
functions.doc: Same current-output gates after required or optional edits in both entries.

functions.name: _prepare_paper_data_checklist
functions.doc: Build the deterministic evidence checklist before the writing call.

functions.name: _primary_output_health
functions.doc: Same artifact/type checks on first execution, retry and checkpoint edits.

functions.name: _primary_output_size
functions.doc:
Return meaningful source size for a possibly split LaTeX manuscript.

``paper/main.tex`` is often only an assembly file whose real content lives
under ``paper/sections``.  Measuring the root alone falsely classified a
complete split manuscript as an empty shell and launched paid retries.

functions.name: _process_retry_policy
functions.doc:
Classify a failed runner result and return ``(kind, retry_budget)``.

The budget is the number of *additional* model processes allowed.  It does
not weaken any output gate: after the budget is exhausted the step fails
visibly instead of repeatedly submitting an identical request.

functions.name: _public_workflow_error
functions.doc: Return a bounded diagnostic safe to persist and show in the client.

functions.name: _read_assets_index
functions.doc:
读取 assets-inventory 步骤产出的 _assets_index.json。

paper_from_assets 工作流用这个 index 决定后续 paper-analysis/paper-figure/
paper-figure-drawio 是否要跑。如果文件不存在或解析失败, 返回安全的默认值
(所有 has_* 都为 False, 这样后续步骤会按"全自动模式"跑)。

Returns:
    dict, 形如:
    {
        "has_problem": bool,
        "has_code": bool,
        "has_data": bool,
        "has_figures": bool,
        "has_results": bool,
        "has_templates": bool,
        "missing_assets": [str, ...],
        "conflicts": [{"type": str, "severity": str, "files": [...]}, ...],
        "conflict_count": int,
        "high_severity_count": int,
    }

functions.name: _read_figure_manifest
functions.doc:
从 PROBLEM_ANALYSIS.md / PAPER_PLAN.md / MODELING_REPORT.md 读
<!-- BEGIN FIGURE_MANIFEST --> 区块, 提取规划的图表名字。

Returns: (data_figs, drawio_figs)
    - data_figs:    数据图章节 (paper-figure 应产出)
    - drawio_figs:  DrawIO/HTML 章节 + TikZ 章节 (paper-figure-drawio/-html 应产出)
    - 找不到 manifest 时返回 ([], [])

分类优先级:
    1. 按 manifest 三章节标题归类(权威) —— 见 _classify_manifest_by_sections
    2. 无规范章节结构时 fallback 到文件名前缀分类(旧逻辑, 对
       「关键词在中间」的架构图会误判, 仅作兜底)

functions.name: _record_pdf_vision_attempt
functions.doc: Atomically retain only bounded retry metadata, never OCR text or secrets.

functions.name: _record_step_progress
functions.sig: (db, workflow_id: 'str', skill_name: 'str', message: 'str', *, phase: 'Optional[str]' = None, level: 'str' = 'info') -> 'None'
functions.doc:
Persist and broadcast a user-readable long-running phase boundary.

Raw runner output can be sparse while a model is reading files or a local
command is executing.  These bounded messages survive reconnects and make
every additional paid model pass explicit without exposing prompts,
commands, keys, or hidden reasoning.

functions.name: _recovery_outputs_pass
functions.sig: (workspace, skill_name, primary, template, params, *, progress, cancelled)
functions.doc:
A later completed step is not evidence that these current files passed.

Reuse the normal current-artifact checks, including stale PDF repair. This
path never invokes a model and advisory-only issues do not force a rerun.
Missing evidence returns to the normal bounded repair path, not success.

functions.name: _repair_docx_source
functions.sig: (db, workflow_id, visible_skill, plan_skills, workspace, params, title, source, reason, attempt)

functions.name: _required_companions_for
functions.doc:
获取该 skill 必须存在的二级文件列表.

dev-code 特殊: 必需文件按项目类型区分 (纯前端/CLI/脚本没有 code/backend/main.py,
强制要求会误判失败)。全栈才要后端入口, 其余只要 code/ 下有主入口 + RUN.md。

functions.name: _resolve_competition_page_rule
functions.doc:
Return the final-submission page reference for one competition.

Every competition uses ``advisory_max`` locally: the value is visible to the
user but never becomes a generation, expansion, or compression gate.

functions.name: _resolve_step_effort
functions.doc:
解析工作流某步应使用的思考强度（Claude CLI `--effort`）。

取值优先级（与 _resolve_step_model 同一条链）：
  params.step_efforts[skill] > params.effort（整个工作流统一）
  > 全局设置 default_effort > ""（不传 flag，等价于 API 默认 high）

查库异常 / 脏值 / params 为 None → 一律返回 ""，执行时不带该参数。
绝不因为「设个思考强度」把执行搞崩 —— 与 _resolve_step_model 的容错口径一致。

functions.name: _resolve_step_model
functions.doc:
解析工作流某步应覆盖的 executor 模型 {model_id, api_key}。
取值优先级：params.step_models[skill] > params.model_preset_id（整个工作流统一）> None（回退角色默认/全局）。
显式选择的预设失效时暂停；只有未选择预设才返回 None。

functions.name: _resolve_template
functions.doc:
根据 params 动态重写 template 的 sub_steps（中文替换 / docx 模式 / format-profile 插入）。

创建工作流时和运行时都用这个函数，确保 tmpl.sub_steps 与数据库中的 step list 完全一致，
避免 step_index 错位导致 expected_outputs 张冠李戴。

functions.name: _run_native_docx_precheck
functions.doc: Check current source before EVERY conversion; diagnostics stay external.

functions.name: _run_recovery_skill
functions.doc: Safe retries for *repair* calls too, not only the initial main call.

functions.name: _scan_workspace
functions.doc: 扫描工作区，返回非隐藏文件列表，排除 CLAUDE.md 等系统文件。

functions.name: _serialize_workspace
functions.doc: Background writers wait their turn instead of failing a workflow.

functions.name: _should_skip_step_by_assets
functions.doc:
对 paper_from_assets 工作流, 根据 _assets_index.json 决定是否跳过当前步骤。

决策规则:
- paper-analysis: 如果用户已传 code + results, 跳过(不要重跑覆盖)
- paper-figure: 如果用户已传 figures 且没有 missing 标识缺图, 跳过
- paper-figure-drawio: 如果 figures/ 中已有 fig_roadmap.* 或不在 missing_assets 中提到 roadmap, 跳过

Args:
    workspace: 工作区路径
    skill_name: 当前 step 的 skill 名
    template: 工作流模板名(只对 paper_from_assets 生效)

Returns:
    (should_skip, reason): 是否跳过, 跳过原因

functions.name: _step_data_problem
functions.doc:
Single-step delivery must not skip deterministic data errors.

Missing model self-attestation alone is not a broken artifact. Only an
explicit fatal, or inability to perform the required check, blocks here.

functions.name: _step_inactivity_timeout
functions.doc:
Bound silent model calls without shortening any visible work.

Competition manuscript and compile steps should continuously emit tool or
compiler events.  Forty-five silent minutes indicates a stalled provider
request, not productive writing; other legacy steps keep the conservative
ninety-minute allowance.

functions.name: _template_step_for
functions.doc:
Bind output/quality contracts by identity, never a stale ordinal.

Imported/custom workflows can omit or insert steps. Using step_order as
an index into today's template attaches another Skill's output contract.

functions.name: _wait_for_extracts
functions.doc:
等待 user_data 目录所有 PDF/DOCX 异步提取完成 (done 或 failed).

异步提取由 services/extract_worker.schedule_extract 排队,
状态记录在 user_data/.extract_status.json.

超时 (默认 5 分钟) 也直接返回, 不阻塞 workflow 启动 —
单个文件提取失败不应该让整个 workflow 失败.

functions.name: _write_step_handoff
functions.doc: Atomically record artifact evidence used by the next Skill/new session.

functions.name: check_exported_docx_submission_contract
functions.sig: (workspace: 'Path', docx_path: 'Path', skill_name: 'str', *, checker_root: 'Path | None' = None, write_reports: 'bool' = True) -> 'PaperSubmissionContractReport'
functions.doc: Validate the final Word artifact, using real pagination when possible.

functions.name: check_paper_modeling_quality
functions.doc:
Compare upstream formulation depth with the completed paper.

Detect definite structural omissions. A passing result does not certify the
derivation: the writer must still compare each mechanism chain against its
actual formulation and solver, as described in the shared paper contract.

functions.name: check_paper_submission_contract
functions.sig: (workspace: 'Path', skill_name: 'str', *, require_compiled: 'bool | None' = None, checker_root: 'Path | None' = None, write_reports: 'bool' = True, final_source: 'bool' = False) -> 'PaperSubmissionContractReport'
functions.doc:
Check the phase-appropriate paper submission contract.

LaTeX writing steps run only deterministic source checks: no directory or
forced body page break, numbered display math, and the abstract's source
structure/content contract.  The final compiler step owns rendered-page,
style, AI-language and report/PDF snapshot checks. Word has a later native
export step too: that step requests final_source before accepting delivery.

functions.name: clear_pause_request
functions.doc:
清除暂停标记。⛔ 所有启动路径（start/resume/restart/rerun/心跳复活/重启恢复/
检查点续跑）都必须调用，否则工作流会在下一步立刻自杀、再也起不来。

functions.name: context_overflow_action
functions.doc:
Return the only safe retry decision for an Autocompact rapid refill.

A context overflow is deterministic for the same fixed prompt. Retrying it
through a generic eight-attempt loop only repeats the cost. The caller may
rebuild a compact prompt once; if that compact attempt also trips the
breaker it must stop and surface an actionable error.

functions.name: core_file_problem
functions.doc: Return a proven core defect (or unavailable check), never a size hint.

functions.name: effective_skill_name
functions.doc: The same trusted variant mapping must serve planning and execution.

functions.name: finish_local_operation
functions.doc:
Keep the workspace lock until a non-cancellable worker stops writing.

Cancelling asyncio.to_thread does not stop the thread. Deferring the
cancellation prevents pause/restart from launching a second export while
the first converter is still writing the same file.

functions.name: format_workspace_index
functions.doc:
Return a deterministic, strictly bounded model-facing file index.

Small workspaces retain their complete file list.  Large raw-data trees are
represented by exact counts, extension distributions and deterministic
first/middle/last examples.  The summary is only a prompt optimisation: it
never changes the caller's complete list or the files on disk.

functions.name: materialize_skill_templates
functions.sig: (skill_name: 'str', skill_package: 'Path', workspace_path: 'Path', *, template_skill_name: 'Optional[str]' = None, progress: 'Optional[Callable[[str], Awaitable[None]]]' = None) -> 'bool'
functions.doc:
Install the authenticated template tree required by ``skill_name``.

Template ownership is explicit.  In particular, the Huawei writer uses
the signed ``comp-paper-zh/templates/huawei`` bundle; it must never silently
fall back to a generic ``ctexart`` document when that bundle is missing.
The same helper is used by the workflow pre-copy stage and by the runner so
the first writing step sees exactly the tree that the CLI sees.

functions.name: normalize_ai_disclosure
functions.doc:
Return a canonical disclosure payload or ``None`` when disabled.

``strict=False`` is used only while reopening legacy workflows.  It still
never invents missing facts; instead it returns an explicit invalid marker
which makes the paper step stop and request a fresh, truthful declaration.

functions.name: payer_task
functions.doc:
Create a durable task context; nested tools inherit the outer task.

Identity receives bound function arguments. Scope creation is I/O-free;
capture happens at the first model boundary, inside the caller's own safe
pause/error handling. Context follows asyncio tasks and asyncio.to_thread.

functions.name: pending_check_state
functions.doc:
Durable pause metadata in the existing diagnostic column (old DB safe).

It is not a successful-execution receipt. Continuing still evaluates the
current step and all its checks; no existing file is treated as approval.

functions.name: protected_content_error
functions.doc: Expose a bounded error code and action, never raw remote error text.

functions.name: recover_checked_step
functions.sig: (*, check: 'Callable[[], Awaitable[list[CheckIssue]]]', repair: 'Callable[[str, int], Awaitable[None]]', snapshot: 'Callable[[], object]', progress: 'Callable[[str, str], Awaitable[None]]', cancelled: 'Callable[[], bool]', max_repairs: 'int' = 3, max_local_rechecks: 'int' = 2, max_advisory_repairs: 'int' = 1) -> 'int'
functions.doc:
Recheck *all* gates after each targeted repair; return actual repairs.

Cancellation, unavailable checkers and unsafe runner failures propagate.
A first unchanged repair gets one fresh diagnostic attempt; a second
unchanged repair stops. A changed reason is progress even without edits.
Advisory-only findings get a separate best-effort budget, never consume
hard repair attempts and never prevent completion on their own. Any hard
defect introduced by optimization must pass the same checks again.
Unresolved blocking issues never become successful execution.

functions.name: repair_attempt_prompt
functions.doc: A further repair must investigate current evidence, not replay prose.

functions.name: report_from_runner_result
functions.doc: Read a trusted runner-side report and reject inconsistent payloads.

functions.name: request_pause
functions.doc: 标记用户要求暂停。pause 接口调用，步骤循环每步开头检查。

functions.name: require_execution_mode
functions.doc: Admit only explicitly wired account execution; never resolve a Key.

functions.name: retry_unavailable_check
functions.doc:
One retry of an idempotent tuple/report check, never a workflow step.

Resolve/materialize tools again to recover stale paths and transient file
locks. Content failures are returned immediately to focused repair. Keep
this at the outer check boundary, not around every nested subprocess.

functions.name: run_single_step
functions.doc: 单独执行工作流中的单个步骤。

functions.name: run_workflow
functions.doc: 逐步执行子步骤。支持从暂停处恢复（跳过已完成步骤）。

functions.name: submission_advisories
functions.doc: Preserve explicit advisory severity; never downgrade an error by text.

functions.name: submission_repair_prompt
functions.doc: One phase-aware repair contract for automatic and collaborative runs.

functions.name: unfinished_sections
functions.doc:
Only empty/explicitly unfinished active chapters warrant continuation.

Short valid chapters and unused drafts are not incomplete work. Before
main.tex exists, the current plan can still identify missing draft files.
Missing inputs in an assembled paper remain the compiler's responsibility.

functions.name: update_workflow
functions.doc: 更新工作流字段，带重试逻辑应对并发锁竞争。

errors.name: AccessModeError
errors.doc: Inappropriate argument value (of correct type).

errors.name: AccountError
errors.doc: Common base class for all non-exit exceptions.

errors.name: ProtectedContentUnavailable
errors.doc: A protected task cannot continue, but the desktop process remains healthy.

errors.name: RepairStopped
errors.doc: A runner failure with explicit evidence whether all work has stopped.

errors.name: StepCheckPending
errors.doc: Recovery stopped safely, but neither execution nor quality has passed.

errors.name: StepExecutionFailed
errors.doc: A repair/continuation did not finish; its files cannot prove success.

errors.name: StepRepairInterrupted
errors.doc: Unsafe/incomplete repair: retain receipts, do not blindly replay.

errors.name: _DocxPrecheckFailure
errors.doc: Unspecified run-time error.

services.workspace_cleanup.doc:
工作区受保护运行材料清理。

设计目标：把 shared-scripts 和引用材料的明文暴露窗口压缩到
单个受保护调用/本地脚本实际执行期间；模板为兼容后续 LaTeX
预复制只保留到工作流终态。三者都绝不整体进入导出包。

清理触发时机：
- 每个受保护 Skill 调用结束（_utils/_references）
- 编辑器临时脚本执行结束
- 工作流 status = completed / failed / paused
- 进程退出 atexit（正常关闭兜底）
- 周期清扫（每 30 分钟扫一次，处理 SIGKILL / 崩溃漏网）

暂停/恢复和后续 step 会重新走签名 Capsule 校验。暂停、终态、
异常退出和下次启动都会清除全部保留目录。

functions.name: _desktop_workspace_is_managed
functions.doc: Packaged cleanup may only operate below the app-owned workspace root.

functions.name: _final_atexit_cleanup
functions.doc: 进程正常退出时的最后兜底（SIGKILL 时不会跑，靠周期清扫兜底）。

functions.name: _is_reparse_point
functions.doc: Detect Windows junctions/symlinks without following their target.

functions.name: _key_of
functions.doc:
工作区路径 → 字典 key。resolve 失败时退回原字符串。

mark / unmark / is 三处必须用同一套算法，否则同一工作区算出两个 key，
标记挂上了却查不到（清扫照删）。抽出来就是为了不让三份实现走偏。

functions.name: _refresh_utils_in_use
functions.doc:
心跳：只刷新时间戳，不动引用计数。返回标记是否还在。

与 mark 分开是必须的 —— 心跳若调 mark，计数会随心跳次数一路涨，
配对的 unmark 永远减不到 0，标记就永久留下了。

functions.name: _remove_reparse_point
functions.doc: Remove the link/junction itself, selected from lstat attributes.

functions.name: _scan_and_cleanup
functions.doc: 扫描所有工作区，清理已完成/失败工作流的 _utils/。

functions.name: cleanup_workspace_protected_material
functions.doc:
清除指定工作区下全部 Modex 受保护运行目录。

Args:
    workspace: 工作区根目录
    reason: 触发原因，便于日志追踪
    respect_in_use: 同一工作区仍有另一个受保护调用时不清理
    include_templates: False 用于步骤结束；模板保留到工作流
        终态，兼容下一步的 LaTeX 模板预复制。

Returns:
    True 表示全部清理成功（或本就不存在），False 表示仍在使用或失败

functions.name: cleanup_workspace_utils
functions.doc: Backward-compatible wrapper; now clears every protected runtime dir.

functions.name: is_utils_in_use
functions.doc: 该工作区的 _utils/ 是否正在被使用（计数 > 0 且时间戳未过期）。

functions.name: mark_utils_in_use
functions.doc:
标记工作区的 _utils/ 正在被使用，周期清扫会跳过它（引用计数 +1）。

必须与 unmark_utils_in_use 配对（用 try/finally），否则标记泄漏。

长任务请用 utils_in_use() 上下文管理器，它带心跳；裸调这个函数的标记
会在 _IN_USE_MAX_AGE_SEC 后被判过期。

functions.name: periodic_cleanup_orphan_utils
functions.doc:
周期性清扫"孤儿 _utils/"：工作流已完成/失败但 _utils/ 还残留。

SIGKILL / 进程崩溃时 atexit 不跑，靠这个兜底。

Args:
    workspaces_root: 工作区父目录（如 %APPDATA%/MHAgent/Workspaces）
    interval_sec: 扫描间隔秒，默认 30 分钟

functions.name: purge_legacy_workspace_secret_files
functions.doc:
Remove only the exact credential file generated by pre-v2 clients.

New clients pass GPT Image credentials in the child environment.  This
startup migration is intentionally narrow so it cannot remove user files.

functions.name: purge_orphaned_protected_material
functions.doc:
Startup migration for plaintext left by a crash or pre-2.0.3 client.

This must run before interrupted workflows are resumed.  No Claude/editor
child is alive at that point, so every reserved runtime directory is stale
and will be recreated from a verified Capsule if the workflow resumes.

functions.name: purge_runtime_temp_cache
functions.doc:
Remove only stale, application-generated capture scratch directories.

``temp_root`` must be the application's own ``<data>/tmp`` directory.  We
deliberately do *not* touch ``tmp/claude`` (CLI transcripts/tasks), user
workspaces, session journals, logs, or dependency caches.  Reparse points
and entries younger than the retention window are skipped so a running
capture cannot be deleted from underneath Electron.

functions.name: register_workspace_for_cleanup
functions.doc:
注册工作区，进程退出时兜底清理 _utils/。

每次 claude_runner.decrypt_skills_to_workspace 落盘后调用，
确保即使工作流未正常结束（如崩溃 / SIGKILL），最终也能清理。

functions.name: unmark_utils_in_use
functions.doc:
引用计数 -1，减到 0 才真正撤销标记。不存在时静默返回（幂等）。

为什么要计数而不是布尔标记：同一工作区可能有两处并发挂标记（将来
Agent 模式或导出也跑脚本），布尔标记下内层退出会把外层的标记一起撤掉，
外层还在跑就暴露给清扫了。

services.workspace_context.doc:
Bounded workspace indexes for model-facing prompts.

The workflow engine still keeps the complete file list for change detection and
quality gates.  This module only controls how that list is *presented* to a
model.  Enumerating tens of thousands of homogeneous raw-data paths adds no
semantic value and can refill the Claude context immediately after compaction.

classes.name: Counter
classes.doc:
dict() -> new empty dictionary
dict(mapping) -> new dictionary initialized from a mapping object's
    (key, value) pairs
dict(iterable) -> new dictionary initialized as if via:
    d = {}
    for k, v in iterable:
        d[k] = v
dict(**kwargs) -> new dictionary initialized with the name=value pairs
    in the keyword argument list.  For example:  dict(one=1, two=2)

methods.name: update
methods.doc:
D.update([E, ]**F) -> None.  Update D from dict/iterable E and F.
If E is present and has a .keys() method, then does:  for k in E: D[k] = E[k]
If E is present and lacks a .keys() method, then does:  for k, v in E: D[k] = v
In either case, this is followed by: for k in F:  D[k] = F[k]

classes.name: defaultdict
classes.doc:
defaultdict(default_factory=None, /, [...]) --> dict with default factory

The default factory is called without arguments to produce
a new value when a key is not present, in __getitem__ only.
A defaultdict compares equal to a dict with the same items.
All remaining arguments are treated the same as if they were
passed to the dict constructor, including keyword arguments.

functions.name: context_overflow_action
functions.doc:
Return the only safe retry decision for an Autocompact rapid refill.

A context overflow is deterministic for the same fixed prompt. Retrying it
through a generic eight-attempt loop only repeats the cost. The caller may
rebuild a compact prompt once; if that compact attempt also trips the
breaker it must stop and surface an actionable error.

functions.name: format_workspace_index
functions.doc:
Return a deterministic, strictly bounded model-facing file index.

Small workspaces retain their complete file list.  Large raw-data trees are
represented by exact counts, extension distributions and deterministic
first/middle/last examples.  The summary is only a prompt optimisation: it
never changes the caller's complete list or the files on disk.

services.workspace_mutation.doc:
One in-process writer per workspace, shared by workflows, chat and editor.

The lease belongs to the task, not its HTTP/SSE subscriber. Re-entry is allowed
only in the owning task (ContextVars alone also leak into child tasks).
